mapper.select: SELECT JOB_ID jobId, JOB_NAME jobName, LOOP_DATE_TYPE loopDateType, LOOP_DATE_VALUE loopDateValue, LOOP_DATE_DETAIL loopDateDetail, START_DATE startDate, END_DATE endDate, RULE_ID ruleId FROM REP_JOB job where job.START_DATE <= #{executeDateStr, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and (job.END_DATE is null or job.END_DATE >=#{executeDateStr, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
SELECT ID id, JOB_ID jobId, FLAG flag, RULE_TYPE1 ruleType1, RULE_TYPE2 ruleType2, RULE_TYPE3 ruleType3, RULE_TYPE4 ruleType4 FROM REP_JOB_RANGE rang WHERE rang.JOB_ID =#{jobId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT rule.ID id, rule.REP_ID repId, info.REPORT_NAME repName, rule.RCF_TYPE rcfType, rule.RCF_VALUE rcfValue, rule.BASIS_DATE_TYPE basisDateType, rule.MAKE_TYPE makeType, rule.MAKE_VALUE makeValue, rule.MAKE_DATE_TYPE makeDateType, rule.MAKE_TIME makeTime, rule.REVEAL_TYPE revealType, rule.REVEAL_VALUE revealValue, rule.REVEAL_DATE_TYPE revealDateType, rule.REVEAL_TIME revealTime, rule.DATA_TYPE dataType, rule.DATA_RANGE dataRange, rule.DATA_BEGIN dataBegin, rule.DATA_END dataEnd, rule.DATA_VALUE dataValue, rule.FILE_OUT_TYPE fileOutType, rule.REVEAL_CHANNEL revealChannel, rule.FTP_ID ftpId, rule.IS_CONFIRM isConfirm, rule.IS_REVEAL isReveal, rule.DETAIL detail, info.REPORT_CATEGORY reportCategory FROM REP_RULE rule LEFT JOIN REP_INFO info on rule.REP_ID = info.REP_ID where rule.id =#{ruleId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT PROD_ID prodId, PROD_RE prodRe, PROD_NAME prodName, PROD_ABBR prodAbbr, RAISE_MIN raiseMin, RAISE_MAX raiseMax, RAISE_STRDATE raiseStrdate, RAISE_ENDDATE raiseEnddate, RAISE_CCY raiseCcy, SET_DATE setDate, VDATE vdate, FIRST_OPEN_DAY firstOpenDay, MDATE mdate, ACT_MDATE actMdate, TERM term, WINDUP_DATE windupDate, ISSUE_MODE issueMode, PROFIT_TYPE profitType, PROD_TYPE prodType, ISSUE_STATUS issueStatus, RAISE_TYPE raiseType, RISK_LEVEL riskLevel, REVEAL_CHANNEL revealChannel FROM REP_PROD_INFO where 1=1 ${sqlVal} and p_prod_id is null /*不取子产品*/ AND STATUS = 'E' AND NOT EXISTS(select 1 FROM REP_JOB_EXCLUDE_PRO pro WHERE pro.PROD_ID=REP_PROD_INFO.PROD_ID and pro.JOB_ID=#{jobId, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

SELECT PROD_ID prodId, PROD_RE prodRe, PROD_NAME prodName, PROD_ABBR prodAbbr, RAISE_MIN raiseMin, RAISE_MAX raiseMax, RAISE_STRDATE raiseStrdate, RAISE_ENDDATE raiseEnddate, RAISE_CCY raiseCcy, SET_DATE setDate, VDATE vdate, FIRST_OPEN_DAY firstOpenDay, MDATE mdate, ACT_MDATE actMdate, TERM term, WINDUP_DATE windupDate, ISSUE_MODE issueMode, PROFIT_TYPE profitType, PROD_TYPE prodType, ISSUE_STATUS issueStatus, RAISE_TYPE raiseType, RISK_LEVEL riskLevel, REVEAL_CHANNEL revealChannel FROM REP_PROD_INFO where PROD_ID in( SELECT dt.PRODID FROM REP_INSTALL_LOG_DETAIL dt WHERE dt.JOB_SEQ=#{jobSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND dt.EXEC_STATUS=#{execStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) and p_prod_id is null /*不取子产品*/
SELECT count(1) FROM REP_INVESTDETAIL WHERE STATUS = 'E' AND IS_SCALE_OUT = '01' AND VAL_DATE =#{executeDateStr,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM REP_PROD_ASSET a LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_INFO i ON a.ASSET_ID=i.ASSET_ID AND i.STATUS='E' WHERE a.VAL_DATE=#{executeDateStr,jdbcType=DATE} AND a.STATUS='E' AND i.ASSET_TYPE_ONE='04' AND i.ASSET_BUSI_TYPE='41'
SELECT count(1) FROM REP_TRADE_INFO p where p.STATUS='E' and p.TRADE_DATE=#{executeDateStr,jdbcType=DATE} and p.IS_RELATION_TRADE='01' and p.IS_OUT_TRADE='01'

select count(1) from REP_PROD_ASSET rti left join REP_ASSET_INFO rai on rai.asset_id=rti.asset_id and rai.STATUS='E' where rti.VAL_DATE=#{executeDateStr,jdbcType=DATE} and rti.STATUS='E' and rai.ASSET_TYPE_ONE='04' and rai.IS_STAND_ASSET='N'
SELECT count(1) FROM REP_PROD_INFO_TA WHERE IS_LARGE_SH='1' AND LARGE_SH_DATE=#{executeDateStr,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT count(1) FROM REP_PROD_INFO_TA T WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM REP_PROD_INFO_TA T1 WHERE T.PROD_ID=T1.PROD_ID AND T1.AFTER_RAISE_MAX!=T.AFTER_RAISE_MAX AND T1.CHANGE_DATE = (SELECT MAX(CHANGE_DATE) FROM REP_PROD_INFO_TA WHERE CHANGE_DATE < T.CHANGE_DATE)) AND T.LARGE_SH_DATE = #{executeDateStr,jdbcType=DATE}
